title: PixelKin - The Rime-Lamps (SNES register)
_note: The Rimeway (09-the-wild-ways §2C): the old star-tenders' high road over the frost col above the Pale Vault - a line of dead rime-lamps, wind, the glacier below. Lonely and grand. 92 BPM, 4/4, D minor with sus/quartal colour. Frost signature: quartal pluck arps (D-A-E stacked fifths), slow glassy bell chimes (the dead lamps), a noise 'aurora/wind' swell. Form A (lonely: lead alone over open fifths + wind + lamp chimes) -> B (grand: full strings, processional toms + crash, the leap WIDENED and sequenced upward a step each phrase, a Picardy D major before the turn) -> A' (lonely again, a flute answering from the next dead lamp). Vesper motif: frost = stretched & suspended - A4->D5->E5 hangs on a held E, the settle comes a bar late. Last bar C#-E over A leads into the A4 that opens the loop. 24 bars = ~62.6 s. Original (VISION.md).
